cohort: 214 women with antepartum singleton stillbirths and 428 age-matched controls with live births, from Helsinki University Hospital, Finland (2003-2015)
finding: Women with stillbirth had a higher likelihood of labor induction, shorter labor duration, and increased risks of placental abruption and blood transfusion, but most delivered vaginally without major complications.
mod_finding: Women who experienced stillbirth were more likely to have labor induction and less likely to have cesarean deliveries compared to women with live births.
